consequence.statement: Only the wording of an error message changes: it now shows the cluster URL instead of the full cluster object. Nothing an operator has configured is affected.

assertion.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 error messages that mention a cluster now show the cluster URL instead of the full cluster object.
